newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Panda offers "A" shares at 5.1 yuan each.
newsitem.headline: Panda offers "A" shares at 5.1 yuan each.

text.p: Nanjing Panda Electronics Co Ltd will offer its new issue of 23 million A shares to investors in China at 5.10 yuan per share, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.
The company said the China Securities Regulatory Commission had given it final permission to issue the new A shares and to list them on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on November 18.
A shares are reserved for domestic investors in China.
Net proceeds of about 112 million yuan raised from the issue will be used in the development of multimedia and digital colour television sets, and digital video disc players, it said.
